description: This Java class 'DestinationCommandConsumer' is part of the Eclipse Hono client implementation. It manages an AMQP receiver link for consuming commands directed to a specific device or gateway in an IoT context. The class supports device-specific command handlers, handles remote and local link closures, and facilitates message receipt and dispatching to appropriate handlers. It contains methods for creating consumers, adding handlers, handling received messages, and managing link lifecycle events.

classes.name: DestinationCommandConsumer
classes.description: A class that manages an AMQP receiver link for consuming device or gateway commands, handling message dispatching, handler management, and link lifecycle.

methods.name: addDeviceSpecificCommandHandler
methods.description: Adds a device-specific command handler if the device and gateway IDs match the consumer and no handler already exists for the device.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create and initialize a new DestinationCommandConsumer with appropriate message handling and lifecycle hooks.
